newsitem.title: EGYPT: Watany Bank of Egypt raising capital.
newsitem.headline: Watany Bank of Egypt raising capital.

text.p: The board of Watany Bank of Egypt has proposed raising the bank's authorised capital to 315 million pounds ($93 million) from 105 million, the bank said in an announcement on Friday.
The increase in authorised capital would take place when the bank raises its issued and paid-in capital to 105 million pounds from the current 82.582 million, it said.
The board will put the proposal to a meeting of shareholders in Cairo on May 11, the bank said.

The authoritative economic weekly al-Boursa said last month that the bank had not yet decided how much of the new issued capital to raise through a free share issue to existing shareholders and how much by public subscription.
